review_comments: Only return device info if we have a unique_id.
through config flow we have unique id (serial number) of projector, is this enough?

Yes, but the old config entries may not have a unique id yet. So we need to guard for this somehow. Preferably we shouldn't add the entity at all unless we have all data. Instead get the serial if it's missing and update the config entry and then reload the integration as in my other comment.
Alternatively we could add the entity as unavailable if the device is off until we can get the serial and then update and reload. But then we need to not return incorrect device info here.
We should make the same connection checks here before creating a new entry as when starting a manual flow in the user step. A common pattern is to just pass the imported config on to the user step.
I think we should keep the option to set HTTP port. Do all Epson projectors use the port 80? If we're not sure, keeping this option is a safe bet. We can make it optional.
TCP connection can use 2 ports only 32xx. those ports cannot be changed.
OK, and what about HTTP? Do all Epson projectors use the port 80 only? If so, then it makes sense to remove this option.

HTTP is not official way at all of requesting data from Epson.
It was easier back than (3 yrs ago) for me to just sniff traffic from webview than try to implement protocol (which is also unofficial)
Aha, OK... thanks for the info. I studied only the transport over RS232.
I suggest to keep the port as an optional parameter.
if pure TCP connection will be accepted there is no way to switch ports.

I think we should update the config entry already here before we reload the integration. Otherwise we throw away good data and we're not sure we'll get the same data when reloading the integration. Maybe the projector turns off just after this?

I didn't realize we had already set a unique id using the config entry entry_id. Then we need to migrate all the existing entity entries to use the new unique_id. There is a helper to migrate entity entries in the entity registry.
We want to migrate before loading the platform.
We should also set unique id of existing config entries that don't have that set yet.
It will be done by media_player entity, right?

This PR changes config-flow data scheme, but it provides no migration to newer version.

We should increment config flow data version to 2 and add the migration like this:
```python
async def async_migrate_entry(_, config_entry: ConfigEntry):
    """Migrate old entry."""
    _LOGGER.debug("Migrating from version %s", config_entry.version)

    if config_entry.version == 1:
        new = {**config_entry.data, CONF_PROTOCOL: PROTO_HTTP} # customize for this case
        config_entry.data = {**new}
        config_entry.version = 2

    _LOGGER.info("Migration to version %s successful", config_entry.version)
    return True
```
old config flow didn't have proper unique id set and I don't think it can be migrated as it won't recognize old config...
It's about the port entry. All instances with current config flow have the port option set. During migration, you should remove that option from the list and bump version number.
ok, I will do that

I tried to implement migration and I don't see anyway to do it properly.
I need serial number of projector in new config and I can get it only while projector is turned on.
In migration process I don't have a way to ask user to turn on projector and force migration will just extend errors during HA restart process.
Does it mean this is a breaking change, and new config entries will be created for the projectors?
it's creating new config_entry for most user on each restart right now, so I'd call it bugfix.
